shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'SKILL.md' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 16 '"'^## (DashKit|Charts|Navigation)'"' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls -a; npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/navigation peerDependencies'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -90; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md; rg -n -A 45 'Branding|brand|--g-color-base-background' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit @gravity-ui/charts@1 @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -200; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md | head -130; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -60; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/{dashkit,charts,navigation} | rg '(INDEX.md|types.d.ts|AsideHeader.d.ts|Chart.d.ts|DashKit.d.ts|package.json)"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -85; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -75; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts | head -130; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -180; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm | rg '(typings|types/|settings)' | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/area/types.d.ts | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/pie/types.d.ts | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/{plugin,common,config}.d.ts | head -200; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/config.d.ts | head -110; rg -n 'gridLayout|rowHeight|cols|compactType|isMobile' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/*; rg -n 'css|style' node_modules/@gravity-ui/{navigation,dashkit}/package.json; rg -n 'CSS|--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader/README.md | head -50; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types | head -30; rg -n 'export.*(Layout|Chart|Arrow|Gear|CircleQuestion|Bell|Plus|Calendar|Ellipsis|Check|Xmark|Persons|Target|Sliders|Grip|Magnifier|Database|ArrowDown)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -70; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts | head -75"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types | head -25; rg -n 'innerRadius|borderRadius|curve|dashStyle|lineWidth|opacity|tickInterval|format|grid|visible' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/{series,axis,chart}*.d.ts | head -65; rg -n 'CSS|--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | tail -35; rg -n 'as (Layout|Chart|Gear|CircleQuestion|Bell|Plus|Calendar|Ellipsis|Check|Xmark|Persons|Target|Sliders|Grip|Magnifier|Database|ShoppingBag|Chevron|ArrowUpRight|ArrowDownToLine|CircleCheck|ArrowsRotateRight)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -110; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -70; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts | head -70; node -e \"for(const p of ['dashkit','charts','navigation','icons'])console.log(p,require('@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '\"version\"|\"exports\"|css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/{dashkit,charts,navigation,icons}/package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/index.d.ts | head -40; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | rg '(area|pie|axis|chart).*d.ts"'$'"' | tail -25; rg -n -- '--gn-aside|--gn-color|--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -30; rg -n 'innerRadius|lineWidth|dashStyle|curve|grid|tickInterval' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/*.d.ts | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.d.ts | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types | head -30; rg -n 'innerRadius|lineWidth|dashStyle|curve|tickInterval|grid|visible|opacity' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/*.d.ts | head -60; rg -o -- '--gn-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | sort -u; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/{area,line,pie}.d.ts | head -180; rg -n -A 5 'grid|visible|categories|labels|tickInterval|min\\?|max\\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis*.d.ts | head -75; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts | head -80; rg -n -A 4 'margin|spacing' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/*.d.ts | head -25; rg -n 'data:|size|onRowClick|width' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts | tail -12; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 3 'innerRadius|borderWidth|borderRadius|dataLabels|value:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/pie.d.ts; rg -n 'visible|grid|tickInterval|tickPixelInterval|lineColor|type\\?|categories|min\\?|max\\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg -n 'interpolation|dashStyle|lineWidth' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts; cat tsconfig.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '27,39p' src/App.tsx; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | sed -n '170,207p'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/pie.d.ts | sed -n '30,58p'"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace('}]}} />','}]}}} />').replace('}]}}/>','}]}}}/>')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "cat index.html; rg -n 'noOverlay|draggableHandle|isResizable|resizeHandles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js | head -30; rg -n -A 3 'var\\(|getComputedStyle|resolveColor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color*.js | head -30; git diff --stat; test -d node_modules/prettier && echo prettier-installed"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 3 -B 3 'isResizable|draggableHandle|isDraggable|noOverlay' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayoutWrapper.js | head -70; rg -n 'itemsStateAndParams|salt|counter|layout' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/config.js | head -20; git status --short; npm run build > /tmp/orbit-build.log 2>&1; tail -10 /tmp/orbit-build.log"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n --glob '*.js' 'draggableHandle:|isResizable:|isDraggable:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout | head -16; rg -n --glob '*.js' 'draggableHandle:|isResizable:|isDraggable:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components | head -20; cat .gitignore; cat vite.config.ts"
